name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
title: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd - 533229 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin hit 63% and EBITDA margin 25% standalone on MLH price cuts and mix, with management declining to guide and flagging hyperinflation in LLP and packaging from the Gulf war.

triggers.label: Gross margin 63% in Q4
triggers.quote: our gross margin stood at 63% for the quarter and 60% for the full year

triggers.label: No channel filling, distributor inventory lean
triggers.quote: At a distributor level also, our inventory is very lean and we are very happy with the status of our inventory at distributors.

triggers.label: Frontal pricing needed in Q1 on inflation
triggers.quote: in this quarter, I think we will have to take some amount of frontal pricing as well to manage the quarter

triggers.label: No formal guidance; margin band low-to-mid 20s
triggers.quote: we aspire to maintain margins between the low to the mid 20s

guidance.quote: we aspire to maintain margins between the low to the mid 20s
we will be further focusing on growing this portfolio to around INR500 crores in size over the next three years

red_flags.label: Input cost hyperinflation; price hikes needed
red_flags.quote: the war in the Gulf has created extreme volatility in the prices of LLP and packaging material
